description: Global current weather by city name or lat/lon. Resolves the city (largest match + up to 3 alternatives; optional country or 'City, Region'), returns temp C/F, feels-like, humidity, wind speed/gust/direction, pressure, cloud, precipitation, condition, next 24 hours and 7-day daily summary. Data: MET Norway Locationforecast (CC BY 4.0), GeoNames (CC BY 4.0). Unknown city 400 (free, before payment); upstream down 502, not charged. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/weather/current.

city.description: city name, any case/accents, e.g. 'Paris', 'Portland, ME', 'Sao Paulo' (or use lat+lon)

country.description: optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (or English name) to disambiguate, e.g. US

name: world_weather_current
title: Global current weather + 24h + 7-day by city or lat/lon (MET Norway)
